content: Rut okhebha Boaz
Iwa Naomi ọkhaam ochimmanọng wani, kw'ode ofonanọng kw'Ẹlimẹlẹk. Ojinọng nwa okpen Boaz, kẹ wa ode ọkkọkkaa kw'ọtza che.

Iwa Rut kw'ofon Moab, oben Naomi bi, “Tte nchina k'iwoni, ifha ndor anọng nnam ndungi abarli-mọma p'am-atto, ode na ńne ọnọng kw'osi ọphyaam ọnang-m o.” Naomi obhin-ẹ bi, “Nnwa kwaam, china ororo, si mach'abeni.”
Mẹ wọ, Rut ofona ochina k'owoni, ọttẹwọr om-odungi abarli-mọma otzor anọng p'asi ipha nnam. K'odem kw'idik im-ide, kẹ wa om-osi ọtzọhm k'owoni kwa Boaz, kw'ofon k'efonamma ch'Ẹlimẹlẹk.
Ogbe kobhiri, Boaz ofona ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm opyiri, orima atzọhmnọng p'asi ipha bi, “Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro odo bọng!” Bẹ amọnga erima aben bi, “Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro odo kọ.”
Boaz ọbọbh okker-atzọhmnọng pẹ bi, “Ominanwa kw'anyi wọ kana?”
Okker-atzọhmnọng obhin-ẹ bi, “Kẹ ode ominanwa kw'ofon Moab kw'ọtzọni Naomi abẹ, ofona ka Moab okhuna.
Kẹ ophyem-m bi, nttẹ-ẹ ọbọhk otzor atzọhmnọng mba nnam odungi abarli-mọma. Mada ira ottẹttẹwọr ọtzọhm k'ekpebha mapyiri ma, okwok ọwọhng ibebaa.”
Mẹ wọ, Boaz oben Rut bi, “Nnwa kwaam, yong-m itzọhng. Kọ k'owoni ọdọdọk kàchina bi, atza asi ọtzọhm, owoni nwa ọbọhk kàbira atte. Kọ wobha ma ttara atzọhmnọng paam p'ipanọng.

Kkeri owoni kw'atzọhmnọng am-asi ipha, atzor atzọhmnọng p'ipanọng nnam. Nkk'ajinọng mba itzọhng ndọra bi, bẹ aning-ọ agbọri. Idikha asi adaakh-ọ, rọhng atza agwo ka nsijọ s'ajinọng mba akk'asi akhaabha akhe.”
Mẹ wọ, Rut ọrakha ottima itzitzikha k'irerek oben-ẹ bi, “Kaam nde okhekhennọng, oreng yan kw'asi ọphyaam-dema mva anang-m o?”

Boaz obhin-ẹ bi, “Bẹ akk'aam ejibha kpenamkpen agbaakha, ch'akk'asa anang ọkka-maan-odim kwọ e. Ttẹwọr mada iwa odim kwọ ope-ope, abina aji atte ttara akka, ọmaana anọng pọ, ọmaana obhon kwọ, akwu aruk ttara anọng p'iwa anarong.
Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ochor-ọ k'ọtzọhm f'akk'asa. Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'anọng p'Israẹl, kw'akk'arọbha akwu ajena, ọdọ-ọ ejibh-ejibha.”
Rut obhin-ẹ bi, “Itta kwaam, tte ọphyaam fọ ochina ororo obeng-m ekkema. Kọ akk'aam ottem-bara ananga, abira agbaakh-m attemdini-tzim, kaambi ode bi ebenga-mbọhk kinde ttara atzọhmnọng pọ p'ipanọng.”
K'ogbe kw'ọchattọhk, Boaz oben Rut bi, “Kwu tzọkha brẹd abọhnga k'atzuk mba achi.” Mada Rut okk'ẹwọr k'ottem kw'atzọhmnọng owobha, Boaz ọnang-ẹ abarli-bhaabha, ochi maa ọdọhbh, bẹ arik.
Mada obin bi otza osi ọtzọhm, Boaz oben atzọhmnọng pẹ bi, “Kaambi odungi k'ottem kw'akhe, bọng kẹ kàkkaam.
Bọng tza arọbha agwọk bani k'akhe anang-ẹ, bọng abira attẹ-ẹ ọbọhk odungi, bọng kẹ kàkkaam o.”
Rut osi ọtzọhm m'owoni nwa maa ẹchọhkha etto. Ọkhaani abarli-mọma p'okk'odungi maa bẹ an-arikh-orik afu ẹgbangbang-dim.
Otzini abarli-mọma mba otzima okhuna k'ẹttọhma. Rut ọkhọkha ọkka-maan-odim abarli-mọma haabha p'okk'odungi, obiro ọnang-ẹ ọchattọhk f'ira ochi orik.

Ọkka-maan-odim ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Kọ maan wọ kw'ira ayini mayina? Maan kw'ira asi ọtzọhm o? Tte ẹdaa ewobha ẹnang ọnọng nwuma kw'ọkhọ-ọ otzum.” Mẹ wọ, Rut ọgbaak ọkka-maan-odim odik okhuri ọnọng kw'ira osi ọtzọhm k'ibe sẹ, oben bi “Ojinọng kwa nsi ọtzọhm ttara mayina, okpen Boaz.”

Mẹ wọ e, Naomi oben kwanọng kwa nnwa kwẹ bi, “Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi odo Boaz, kẹ kw'ochin ororo ọkhọkha ekpen-jibha chẹ ọnang anọng p'arukhi akpen, ọmaana p'akk'apa. Ojinọng nwa ode ochimmanọng kwaman, obiro ode ọkkaan-echimma kwaman.”
Mẹ wọ, Rut kw'ofon Moab oben bi, “Ayongi mẹ, ojinọng nwuma oben-m bi, kaam ndungi ndor atzọhmnọng pẹ nnam maa ipha iha.”
Naomi oben Rut kw'ode kwanọng kwa nnwa kwẹ bi, “Nnwa kwaam, ójibh-ojibh bi asi ọtzọhm ttara atzọhmnọng pẹ p'ipanọng, idikha achin k'owoni kw'ọnọng ọdọdọk bẹ ákkaam-ọ ọkkaam e.”
Iwa Rut osi ọtzọhm ọbaanga atzọhmnọng pa Boaz p'ipanọng, maa ipha s'abarli ọmaana erezi-dem ch'ekpen wit, iha. Ogbe nwa biphyir, wa Rut orukhi ttara ọkka-maan-odim kwẹ.
